title: The Country Studies
body: The Federal Research Division Country Studies (and the US Army Area Handbook series they grew from): reference studies of the nations — historical setting, society, economy, government and politics, and national security — prepared by the Library of Congress for the US government and released to the public domain. Gathered and credited, one study per country, each linked to its full public-domain text.
